### Package development and installation in Fractal

This project uses [pixi](https://pixi.sh) to manage the environment.

1. Install the environment and the package (editable) with `pixi install`
2. Develop the function according to the [Fractal API](https://fractal-analytics-platform.github.io/)
3. Run the tests with `pixi run test`
4. Update the image list and the Fractal manifest with `pixi run manifest`
5. Build a wheel file in the `dist` folder of the package with `pixi run build`
6. Collect the tasks on a Fractal server

Some tasks pull in heavy, task-specific dependencies that are shipped as optional extras:

- `spot_detection` needs Spotiflow (and torch): `uv pip install -e ".[spotiflow]"`

::: {.callout-note}
As Fractal tasks are Python functions they can also be executed independently of Fractal e.g. by running

```{python, eval=false}
from operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration import condition_registration

condition_registration(
  zarr_urls=["operetta_plate.zarr/A/1/0"],
  zarr_dir="operetta_plate.zarr",
  layout_path="drug_layout.csv",
  table_backend="csv"
)
```
:::

### Updating the documentation
1. Make your changes to the documentation under `/docs`
2. Regenerate the function API pages with `pixi run docs`
3. Preview the documentation with `pixi run preview`

::: {.callout-note}
`pixi run preview` drives [quarto](https://quarto.org), which must be installed
separately (it is not managed by pixi). The jupyter engine it relies on is
included in the `dev` environment.
:::
